reply: Thank you for explaining that a collection agency placed negative information on your credit without contacting you, and told you a police report was the only way to have it reviewed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send a written dispute to the collector and to the credit reporting companies. If the information is wrong, the company must notify every bureau it reported to. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining your experience with a dental crown that later needed extraction, and the costs you paid out of pocket. We are sorry for the pain and distress this caused. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team, including any balance being pursued. Please keep your receipts, the second-opinion records and any bills or collection letters, and ask the provider in writing for an itemized statement. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your charged-off account was settled and you received the tax form, but your credit report has not been updated. We understand why you want this reflected. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the creditor and the credit reporting companies a copy of the tax form and any settlement letter, and ask that the balance be updated to zero. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collector is pursuing a payday loan you do not recall taking, and that your information was exposed in a data breach. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep your written dispute and identity theft report together, and continue to dispute in writing; a collector should provide verification before continuing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that late payments are still reported on a card account even though you paid on time, and that you want all replies by mail. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team, including your request for written replies. Please include proof of your payment dates for the months shown as late, and keep copies of every dispute you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a negative item was deleted and then reinserted shortly afterwards, and that you have been waiting months for the original contract. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team, including the reinsertion. Please keep the deletion and reinsertion notices and copies of your requests. You can also ask in writing that the collector stop contacting you. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an account on your report is the only negative item affecting your home purchase, and that you have not received the documents you requested. We understand the urgency. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. If you believe this account resulted from identity theft, report it through the federal identity theft website and send that report with your dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collector reported a debt about ten years old that had been removed from your reports last year. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Most negative information can only stay on a report for seven years, so please dispute the entry with each credit reporting company and include proof it was removed before. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you disputed a $1,400.00 collection account and have not received verification or an accounting. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written request for the validation information, including the original creditor and amount, and keep copies. You can also ask in writing that they stop contacting you. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your auto loan servicer calls you several times a day from different numbers even though you are paying every month. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a log of the calls with dates and times and your payment confirmations. Collectors generally cannot call at times or places that are inconvenient to you. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $120.00 collection appeared on your report without any prior notice. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. A collector must follow rules for contacting you before reporting a debt, so please send a written dispute asking for the original creditor, date of default and amount, and keep proof of mailing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are being taken to court for a debt you do not recognize and believe is too old, and that you have filed an answer. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep meeting every court deadline and keep copies of all filings, letters and emails you receive. You may want to seek free legal aid for help with the case. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a charged-off account is not yours and that you have been confused with relatives who share your name. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send a written dispute with proof of your identity, such as your date of birth and address history. A disputed debt is marked on your report during the investigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were denied credit because of accounts you did not authorize, and that you want them blocked. We understand the impact. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list the specific accounts and explain why each one is not yours or is inaccurate. If identity theft is involved, an Identity Theft Report supports a request to block items. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $710.00 collection does not match any of the four card accounts listed on your consumer report. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written request for the original account details, and if the debt duplicates another listing, dispute the duplicate with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you want certain accounts blocked from your consumer report because you did not authorize them. We understand your request. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please identify each account and explain why it is not yours or is inaccurate, and include any supporting documents. Keep copies of everything you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you believe extra fees were added that are not in the contract, and that you could not find the collector's license in your state. We understand your concerns. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask the collector in writing for an itemized balance and its licensing details, and keep copies of the contract and the letter showing the fees. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you want certain accounts blocked and removed because you did not authorize them. We understand your request. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list the accounts and explain why each is not yours or is wrong, with supporting documents. If identity theft is involved, an Identity Theft Report supports the request. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your driver's license was stolen and that fraudulent accounts appear on your credit report. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please report the theft through the federal identity theft website, close any affected accounts, and send the report along with your police report to each company. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent a debt verification letter the day after receiving a $1,300.00 collection notice, received nothing, and now see collections on your reports. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep proof of the date your letter was sent, and dispute the collection accounts with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collection account reports past due amounts and late payments that you believe are inaccurate, and that it was verified without the documents you requested. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send a written dispute to the collector explaining what is wrong, and keep copies. If the information is wrong, it must be corrected with every bureau. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an insurance policy you cancelled when you traded in your car was later sent to collection for the rest of the term. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please gather proof of the cancellation date and the vehicle trade-in, and send it with a written dispute to the collector and the insurer. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a company is trying to collect your son's debt from you, and that you have not received a copy of the contract by mail. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send a written dispute stating the debt is not yours, and ask for the validation information by post. Do not open links you are unsure about. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you dispute a lease debt because the people listed never signed a lease with the company. We understand your position. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask the collector in writing for a copy of the signed lease and an itemized balance. If they say you signed, you can ask for evidence such as the contract. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an instant transfer shows as delivered but your recipient never received it, and that the case was closed without the transaction details you were told you would receive. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. Please keep your receipt and the recipient's bank records, and ask in writing for the trace details of the transfer. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that coins sent back to the exchange by mistake were acknowledged as received, but support has not responded since. We understand how long you have waited. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. Please keep the transaction ID, the original ticket number and the acknowledgment you received, and ask for a written update on the recovery. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining your side of a dispute with a buyer who claims the device you sold was damaged, and that you have reported the matter to police. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. Please keep the photos, videos, proof of purchase and messages, including the buyer's admission, and your police report number. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that about $58,000.00 in payments were redirected to a fraudulent account through scammers posing as your contractor. We are very sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, together with the steps already taken by your bank and the police. Please keep all reports, tracer details and correspondence, and contact your banks only through numbers you trust. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account has been restricted for some time even after you provided your ID, selfie and bank details, and that about $1,500.00 is locked. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep confirmation that you submitted the documents and a record of your attempts to reach support. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your experience of a transfer that was lost to fraud and your concern about protections for people who use these services. We are sorry this happened to you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. Please keep the transaction details, your reports to each organization and any responses. Only send money to people you know and trust. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
